The plate holds a roll and a piece of rotisserie chicken. The roll is about 15 cm long and small, like a mini baguette or sub roll, so roughly 60 g and 170 kcal.

The chicken looks like half a breast with skin and some loose skin and meat. It is perhaps 150 g including skin, and the bone may have been removed or hidden. Rotisserie chicken breast with skin runs about 200 kcal per 100 g, so about 300 kcal for the chicken.

Together that is about 210 g and about 470 kcal.
